moments.text: Infrared view over a choppy sea: a small dark dot sits just above centre while a blue crosshair and N marker drift around it.
The dot becomes a larger round white spot with a dark rim; the crosshair slides over onto it, then drifts away again.
Black blocks fill the lower right of the picture; at 22.3 s the video cuts to a darker sea with the spot still above centre.
The contrast flips: the spot turns black with a bright rim and short spikes, and dark streaks show on the water.
Normal contrast returns; the white spot holds above centre as waves slide past, with short rays flickering around it now and then.
Thin bright rays grow from the spot and peak in a large starburst at 1:27.77, gone a frame later. Use frame step.
A black band covers the bottom of the picture for about two seconds.
The picture turns blocky and smeared; the spot shrinks to a faint speck and is lost among bright patches by about 3:22.
